authorization: User requests native BAGEL versus DepGraph-U using GPU2/GPU3 and explicitly permits architecture-specific adaptation, reporting actual speed and quality with non-applicable components disclosed.

generation.scope: Auxiliary one-image-per-prompt evaluation, not the standard four-image-per-prompt leaderboard protocol
generation.native: Native BAGEL, TaylorSeer off, full original weights, native prefix KV enabled
generation.ours: BAGEL-adapted DepGraph-U: fixed Wanda-style structured FFN pruning in generation expert, native TaylorSeer cache policy, PR307-equivalent last-layer history optimization, CADD early dependency dispatch
generation.calibration: Two frozen synthetic prompts, native full forwards, seeds600/601; no benchmark labels or quality scores used
generation.non_applicable: Show-o2 Head-A/Head-B split is absent. Generation vocabulary projection is already absent in native BAGEL and receives no new credit. DLS and hybrid FFN switching are not introduced into the Taylor history.
generation.correctness: Two disjoint same-policy cases compare pruned TaylorSeer policy-only with CADD: exact velocity/scheduler traces, pixels, initial noise, RNG; native versus combined is approximate and scored independently
generation.timing: Synchronized wall time, prompt processing through VAE decode, excludes loading, calibration, trace/hashes and PNG I/O; alternate native/ours order across prompts; diagnostic timing excluded
generation.scoring: Independent official GenEval scorer invocation for each arm; require553 unique outputs and six category macro scores

understanding.native: Official BAGEL model.chat API, native incremental KV, full original weights; do not disable KV or use redundant high-level CFG contexts as baseline
understanding.ours: BAGEL-adapted stable-graph DepGraph-U: fixed Wanda-style understanding-FFN pruning, native incremental KV plus guarded append-only cache buffer; no dynamic layer skipping
understanding.calibration: Four fixed synthetic448px colored square/black circle images; no MMStar calibration
understanding.correctness: Two synthetic same-pruned-policy cases compare native KV storage and guarded buffer; exact logits, layer-stack outputs, all visible key/value states and RNG; require actual guarded append calls
understanding.score: Official-style option prefix extraction; unweighted L2 category accuracy mean, percentage; retain raw answers for independent reaggregation
understanding.timing: Synchronized official chat including image transform/ViT/prefill/decode; alternate paired order; input decoding/file I/O and hashes excluded

attribution: FlashU structured FFN ranking/pruning principle; adapted to separate BAGEL MoT experts
BAGEL official implementation and native KV/vocabulary behavior
TaylorSeer native BAGEL cache provider; not relabeled as FlashU diffusion-head caching or as new work
Public BAGEL PR307-equivalent last-layer cache optimization; credited, not claimed as a new contribution
DepGraph-U CADD early dispatch; prior validated BAGEL port
New bounded BAGEL fixed-graph append-buffer adaptation; distinct from original Exact-DLS rebuilding experiments
gates: Stop on source/weight/identity/correctness errors; no gate on favorable latency or quality, no score-based parameter tuning, no hidden retries; retain setup failures and negative outcomes
comparison_boundary: Full-system gains over native include inherited pruning/cache policy gains. Same-policy equality never implies equality or losslessness versus native BAGEL.
scope_limit: This tests the stated BAGEL adaptations, not every Show-o2 component or the original complete FlashU stack. Missing or already-native components must remain explicit in Table7 and the protocol.
